card.name: Inside drug salt names
card.fires_on: Partway through the salt part of a drug name, just before the ending such as chloride, bromide, maleate, succinate or sulfate. It also fires on the space or letter right before 'sulfate'.

modes.label: Salt name mid-spelling
modes.description: Partway through a salt word like bromide, maleate or hemisuccinate after the drug name.
modes.example: Hydrocodone Bitartrate and Homatropine Methylb<<rom>>ide Oral Solution (Syrup)

modes.label: Just before sulfate
modes.description: The space or first letter just before 'sulfate' after a vinca drug name.
modes.example: The concentration of Vincristine<< S>>ulfate Injection is 1 mg/mL

card.writes: It pushes toward sulfate and phosphate-type salt endings, so the model completes the salt name.
card.plain: It marks the spot inside a drug's salt name, such as hydrochloride or bromide, where the rest of the salt word comes next.
